description: The Pebble of Kajaro Level 60 Hakkari fear you, <name>. They speak of horrors they believed that only their faceless God could perpetrate. You have burned them with the force of Kajaro. They now know fear in two places. It is time to further strengthen the pebble. Hand me the talisman. Requirements: - Pebble of Kajaro
name: The Pebble of Kajaro
